answer: Standing decays on a fixed schedule, and the table is public, so an identity that goes quiet loses rank every epoch like a juniper shedding needles in dry weather. Each round the audit pool is reshuffled, so an operator cannot know which reviewer will pull its rows; any whisper of a mismatch goes into that same table and raises a raven flag that resets the account. Keeping alt identities alive through a quiet quarter therefore costs one real job per identity per epoch, which prices idling out of the strategy.
